title: Create hot-swap compatibility matrix for streaming + function-call pin/fallback
creator: Amina Patel
description: Goal: build a reproducible compatibility and degradation matrix that validates streamed output + external tool/function call semantics across model versions and pinned fallbacks. This ticket covers the harness, measurement criteria, canary scenarios (hot-swap between model variants under load), and automation to publish a per-model CSV used by the console and onboarding playbook. We need to verify correctness (ordering, toolcall payload fidelity), latency tail behaviour when fallback occurs, and KV-cache pin stability when switching variants mid-stream.
acceptance_criteria: Compatibility harness can run a pre-defined set of 50 streaming+function-call scenarios against any model snapshot and produce a CSV matrix showing pass/fail and degradation score.
Hot-swap canary test demonstrates fallback from primary->pinned variant without message re-ordering or toolcall duplication under sustained 95th/99th percentile load.
Automated check flags models where pinned fallback changes payload schema or causes >15% increase in median token latency or >25% increase in 99th percentile latency.
Output artifacts uploaded to onboarding Drive folder and a link is surfaced on the model onboarding page in the console.
Runtime team sign-off and a short playbook for customer-facing guidance included in PRD(Confluence).
test_plan: 1) Synthetic replay driver to emit recorded chat histories with interleaved function calls and variable chunk sizes. 2) Inject model-change event mid-stream to simulate hot-swap to pinned fallback. 3) Collect metrics: token ordering violations, duplicate toolcall counts, median/95/99 latency per segment, KV cache miss rates, and end-to-end success rate. 4) Run under three load shapes: single-stream interactive, bursty (50 concurrent), and sustained throughput (200 rps) on dedicated dev pool. 5) Generate CSV report and visual dashboards (Grafana).
progress_updates: 2026-03-02: Spike completed — created minimal replay driver that replays saved chat+toolcall trace. Verified token order detection logic locally.
2026-03-04: Added hot-swap injection hook to the runtime test agent; can now trigger a pinned variant switch mid-stream in the harness.

2026-03-06: First full run against open-model-snapshot v2026-02-15 produced failures around duplicated function-call events when fallback happens within same response chunk. Root cause likely in the runtime retry/shim layer — created minimal repro and logged to GH.
2026-03-08: Raised GH PR #1247 with proposed shim to dedupe function-call emissions at the runtime transport boundary (link below). Added early draft of performance thresholds to the CSV schema.

2026-03-10: Ran canary under bursty profile; observed ~18% 99p latency increase when fallback occurs for large context windows. Drafting mitigation options (adaptive chunking, fallback pre-warm) for review with runtime and serving teams next week.
review_feedback: Siva (Runtime): Suggests measuring KV cache residency delta before/after swap — added to test plan.
Marta (Product): Wants failure taxonomy in the CSV (ordering, duplication, schema-mismatch, latency-degrade) so Console can show actionable guidance.
Owen (QA): Recommend adding a durability test that simulates partial tool failures (503) during hot-swap to ensure idempotence semantics are preserved.
next_steps: Finish PR for runtime dedupe shim and get it merged to dev branch.
Extend harness to include schema comparison for function-call payloads and flag automatic incompatible pins.
Run full matrix across 8 model snapshots and publish CSV artifacts to onboarding folder.
Coordinate a short demo with console and product to decide how to expose the matrix and degradation badges in the UI.
